summary: Brookfield Wealth Solutions filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 press release and results. The foreign private issuer reported total assets of $203.9 billion, quarterly distributable operating earnings of $519 million versus $427 million a year earlier, and net income of $863 million, with per-share figures adjusted for a three-for-two stock split completed October 9, 2025. Highlights included $4 billion of annuity sales and over $8 billion deployed into Brookfield-originated strategies; management discussed optimizing the Just Group platform. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock is disclosed, so no special-situation angle applies.
